name: CA-43
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+27 partisan lean in a heavily Democratic Los Angeles-area district
Long-serving incumbent Maxine Waters with a large fundraising edge
Little-known Republican challenger with no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price a Democratic win near certain
model.rationale: The district's D+27 lean, Waters' incumbency and fundraising advantage, and Polymarket pricing her at 95% all point to an easy Democratic hold; the challenger shows no financial or polling support. A modest pull toward the fundamentals-based margin keeps the forecast comfortably in Safe D territory.
model.watch: A surprise surge in challenger fundraising or name recognition, or unusually low-turnout dynamics in a low-profile general, could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Maxine Waters, a longtime incumbent, seeks another term in a Los Angeles-area district that leans Democratic by 27 points. She has raised over $860,000 and holds a large cash advantage, while Republican Cristian Morales reports no fundraising and has drawn little outside support or attention. No public polls or expert ratings exist for the race, but prediction markets price a Waters win at roughly 95%.

The fundamentals strongly favor the incumbent: the district's partisan lean, her incumbency bonus, and her financial edge all point the same direction. Barring an unforeseen shift, this seat is expected to remain safely in Democratic hands in November.
